name: Feature / improvement
about: A change to make, with its acceptance criteria

## Context
Why this change (evidence, journal numbers, review findings). One concern
per issue — split if it mixes >3 files or config+code+tests.

## Proposed change
What changes, where, and the design decision behind it.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] ... (testable statements; each = a test or a diff)

## Risk / rollback
What could go wrong; how to revert (revert commit / flag to flip back).
